title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Renaming Its Enforcement Work Office as the Enforcement Bureau
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Renaming this Court's Enforcement Work Office as Enforcement Bureau

Fa Fa [2008] No. 31

To: the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In order to comprehensively strengthen enforcement work and deepen the reform of the enforcement system and work mechanism, with the approval of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission, the "Enforcement Work Office of the Supreme People's Court" is hereby renamed the "Enforcement Bureau of the Supreme People's Court." After the renaming, the specific responsibilities of this Bureau shall be: to enforce the decisions on property in the effective judgments, rulings, and mediation agreements of the first instance of the Supreme People's Court; to enforce other legal instruments that are required by law to be enforced by the Supreme People's Court; to handle matters related to legally supervising and guiding the enforcement work of the people's courts at all levels; to coordinate and resolve enforcement disputes in the judgments and rulings of civil, administrative, maritime, and criminal incidental civil cases across provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; and to participate in the drafting of relevant judicial interpretations.

It is hereby notified.

October 8, 2008
